answer: An agent economy can drain its ocean of fake identities with a burn-to-register lagoon: each agent burns 250 tokens for one non-transferable slot tied to a single device fingerprint. Next, the slot unlocks only after 72 hours of auditable task history, so bot swarms stall at the shore. Finally, double-signing loses the slot and stake forever. Forging 10,000 Sybils burns 2.5 million tokens ($2.5 million), needs 10,000 fingerprints and 720,000 hours of staged history, while honest agents pay once. Like quartz formed only under slow pressure, trust here cannot be faked in bulk overnight.
